tool_analysis:
Step Analysis: The recorded steps show a complete workflow for adding a comment to a GitLab issue. The agent navigated through several pages to reach the target issue, then demonstrated all key interactions: using rich text formatting tools, entering comment text, attaching files, and submitting comments. The agent also explored additional filtering/sorting controls like activity filters, sidebar editing (assignee, labels, milestone, due date, confidentiality), and other features (todo, reactions, comment type dropdown, preview).

Task Definition: Create a tool that adds a comment to a specified GitLab issue with rich text formatting and optional attachments.

Action Plan:
1. Navigate to the target issue URL (requires issue URL as input)
2. Locate and interact with the comment textarea
3. Use rich text formatting tools if needed (optional)
4. Enter comment text with markdown formatting
5. Attach file if specified (optional)
6. Submit the comment
7. Verify comment was added

Variable Identification:
1. issue_url - The URL of the GitLab issue to comment on (required)
2. comment_text - The text content of the comment with markdown formatting (required)
3. attachment_path - Optional file path to attach (optional)
4. comment_type - Type of comment: "comment" or "start_discussion" (optional)
5. use_preview - Whether to preview before submitting (optional)

Step Optimization: The recorded steps include extensive exploration of filtering/sorting controls that are not essential to the core task of adding a comment. The tool should focus only on essential steps: navigation to issue, entering comment text, optional file attachment, and submission. The rich text formatting is handled via markdown syntax in the textarea, not through UI buttons, so those steps can be omitted. The tool should use deterministic steps where elementHash exists for stable elements like the comment textarea and submit button.
name: add_gitlab_issue_comment
description: Add a comment to a GitLab issue with rich text formatting and optional attachments

steps.description: Navigate to the specified GitLab issue page
Enter comment text with markdown formatting into the comment textarea
Click 'Attach a file' button if attachment is specified (file dialog will open)
Select comment type from dropdown (comment or start_discussion)
Click 'Preview' tab to preview formatted comment if use_preview is true
Click 'Comment' button to submit the comment

input_schema.name: issue_url
input_schema.description: Full URL of the GitLab issue to add comment to

input_schema.name: comment_text
input_schema.description: Comment text with markdown formatting (supports **bold**, *italic*, `code`, links, lists, tables, etc.)

input_schema.name: attachment_path
input_schema.description: Optional file path to attach to the comment

input_schema.name: comment_type
input_schema.description: Type of comment to post - 'comment' for regular comment or 'start_discussion' to start a new discussion thread

input_schema.name: use_preview
input_schema.description: Whether to preview the comment before submitting (true/false)
